config.purpose: Tests order-dependence of suffix pairs at the operator level on (C,L,R) simplex. Cross-role pairs test genuine noncommutativity. Same-role pairs (maximally different a_u within class) control for recency/position. Decisive: cross-role TV(AB,BA) > same-role TV(A1A2,A2A1) AND > eps_eq. Gate 1b validates: lumpability R2 0.79-0.98, content dominates 6.3x.

_DESIGN_NOTES.surface_selection: Surfaces chosen to maximize operator contrast while keeping same-role controls maximally different (conservative test). a_u values from Gate 1b Step 3.
_DESIGN_NOTES.class_A_range: a_u from 0.101 (State unchanged) to 0.380 (No changes) â€” 3.8x range
_DESIGN_NOTES.class_M_range: a_u from 0.499 (Changing {var}) to 1.443 ({var} gets reassigned) â€” 2.9x range
_DESIGN_NOTES.cross_role_logic: ASSERT (a_u~0.1, strong suppression) vs MISLEADING (a_u~0.5-1.4, weak/reverse). If K_u operators differ in direction, their composition should be order-dependent.
_DESIGN_NOTES.same_role_logic: Use maximally different a_u pairs within each class. If these show low TV(AB,BA), cross-role noncommutativity cannot be attributed to recency or a_u differences alone.
_DESIGN_NOTES.no_surface_equivalence_needed: Lumpability (R2~0.9) proves K_u is well-defined on (C,L,R). Noncommutativity is tested at operator level, not class level.

composition_pairs._label: cross-role: ASSERT x MISLEADING (main test, max operator contrast)
cross-role: ASSERT x MISLEADING (second pair, different surfaces)
same-role control: ASSERT x ASSERT (max within-class a_u contrast)
same-role control: MISLEADING x MISLEADING (max within-class a_u contrast)

predictions.H_recency_only: Same-role TV(A1A2,A2A1) is comparable to cross-role TV(AB,BA). Despite 3-4x a_u differences within class, order effects are purely positional.
predictions.H_content_noncommutative: Cross-role TV(AB,BA) >> same-role TV(A1A2,A2A1). The ASSERTâ†’MISLEADING vs MISLEADINGâ†’ASSERT order matters content-dependently. K_u operators from different semantic classes do not commute.
predictions.decisive_criterion: Cross-role median TV exceeds same-role max TV AND exceeds eps_eq=0.01.
predictions.strength_note: Same-role controls use maximally different a_u pairs (3.8x and 2.9x contrast), making recency rejection conservative.

config.estimated_calls: 4 pairs x 5 conditions x 24 contexts = 480 calls, ~10 min CPU
